name: Exploring the Horde
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
Azeroth is a large world, and the territory of the Horde is vast. The Undercity, Orgrimmar, and Thunder Bluff all have very unique people and culture.

If you are to be a guest of the horde here on Azeroth, it would do you good to visit each of our capital cities in turn. Speak with my advisor Nazgrel for directions.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions. Use the instructions received to locate and speak with Vol'jin, Cairne Bloodhoof, and Lady Sylvanas Windrunner.
narrative.offerRewardText: So you have returned. I hope that you learned much in your journey. It is my understanding that your people are still establishing themselves in Mulgore. While you wait for them, I'd encourage you to explore the territory around Orgrimmar. The Barrens in particular is always in need of eager adventurers like yourself.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 12 to 13, 3,295 XP in all.

quests.name: Confront Lorthuna
quests.objectiveText: Take the portal to the Rohashi Spires overhead and join Elaadrin Evengale and Ayessa Dawnsinger in their confrontation with the High Priestess Lorthuna.

quests.name: The Fate of Zephras
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Talaanis Shadowsong in Valanaar.

quests.name: What Comes Next
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Ayessa Dawnsinger when you are prepared to leave Zephras Isle.

quests.name: The Earthen Ring
quests.objectiveText: Take the skycutter ship from Zephras Isle to Mulgore and speak with Alana Stormwalker when you arrive.

quests.name: Welcome to Azeroth
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Orgrimmar and speak with Thrall in the Valley of Wisdom.

quests.name: Exploring the Horde
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Nazgrel in Grommash Hold to receive further instructions.
